sources.title: AI features and your website
sources.notes: Supports ordinary search eligibility and snippet requirements for AI features. No extra AI markup is required; inclusion is not guaranteed. For dedicated owner-side generative-AI reporting, use the separate google-generative-ai-report reference and native measurement rule.

sources.title: Creating helpful, reliable, people-first content
sources.notes: Supports original value and transparent authorship and production methods. ARWP editorial workflows are implementation proposals, not a disclosed ranking formula.

sources.title: Spam policies for Google web search
sources.notes: Supports rejecting scaled low-value content, doorway pages, link spam, cloaking, and deceptive practices; applies to generative search responses too.

sources.title: Introduction to robots.txt
sources.notes: Crawl management does not equal guaranteed deindexing or access control.

sources.title: Robots meta tags and HTTP header specifications
sources.notes: Supports noindex and snippet controls. Crawlers must access a page to observe page-level directives.

sources.title: Specify a canonical URL
sources.notes: Canonical signals consolidate duplicates; the publisher preference is not proof of the search engine-selected canonical.

sources.title: Build and submit a sitemap
sources.notes: Supports canonical URL lists and meaningful lastmod. Submission is a discovery hint, not indexing evidence.

sources.title: JavaScript SEO basics
sources.notes: Supports inspecting rendering, links, status handling, and indexable content; server HTML is an ARWP interoperability choice rather than a universal Google requirement.

sources.title: Google Search technical requirements
sources.notes: Supports crawl access, successful status, and indexable content as eligibility requirements; does not promise serving.

sources.title: General structured data guidelines
sources.notes: Markup must represent visible, relevant content and use supported properties. Syntax or Rich Results Test success cannot prove truthful claims or rich-result appearance.

sources.title: Article structured data
sources.notes: Supports article author, date, headline, and image properties where accurate; no authorship credential is created by markup.

sources.title: Dataset structured data
sources.notes: Describes dataset discovery metadata including provenance and distribution. Dataset eligibility is not ordinary search ranking or verified data quality.

sources.title: Organization structured data
sources.notes: Supports identifying real organizations and applicable properties. Do not invent registration, membership, addresses, or corporate scale.

sources.title: Breadcrumb structured data
sources.notes: Describes page hierarchy markup, not keyword paths or a guaranteed search presentation.

sources.title: Introduction to Product structured data
sources.notes: Separates product snippets and merchant listings; select the applicable feature guide and satisfy its current requirements.

sources.title: Local business structured data
sources.notes: Supports accurate location-specific business information. An online-only service must not invent a physical location.

sources.title: Write high-quality reviews
sources.notes: Supports first-hand evidence, relevant quantitative criteria, trade-offs, and comparisons. ARWP scorecards and experiment designs remain publisher proposals.

sources.title: Influencing title links
sources.notes: Supports descriptive distinctive titles and consistency with visible headings. Google may generate a different title link.

sources.title: Control snippets in search results
sources.notes: Supports page-specific descriptions and preview controls; supplied descriptions are not guaranteed to be displayed.

sources.title: Link best practices
sources.notes: Supports real href links, contextual anchors, and links to important pages. No fixed internal-link count is prescribed.

sources.title: Localized versions of pages
sources.notes: Supports reciprocal language alternate annotations and valid regional codes where variants exist.

sources.title: Managing multilingual and multi-regional sites
sources.notes: Supports distinct language URLs and explicit navigation. Translation alone is not evidence of local service availability.

sources.title: Site moves with URL changes
sources.notes: Supports explicit URL mapping, redirects, updated references, and migration monitoring; traffic fluctuations remain possible.

sources.title: Managing crawling of faceted navigation URLs
sources.notes: Current destination of the Search Central guide. Supports controlling unbounded URL combinations; not blanket deletion of useful filtered pages.

sources.title: HTTP status codes and Google crawlers
sources.notes: Current destination of the Search Central guide. Successful HTTP transport does not prove the content is useful or indexed.

sources.title: Image SEO best practices
sources.notes: Supports descriptive context, accessible images, stable delivery, and applicable image metadata; no visibility guarantee.

sources.title: Video SEO best practices
sources.notes: Supports dedicated watch pages where appropriate and stable accessible media. An indexed page does not establish video indexing.

sources.title: Understanding page experience
sources.notes: Supports useful page experience without treating a single score as a complete ranking or quality measure.

sources.title: Web Vitals
sources.notes: Supports LCP, INP, CLS and field assessment at the 75th percentile by device. Lab results must not be presented as field measurements.

sources.title: Search documentation updates
sources.notes: The FAQ rich result was discontinued starting 2026-05-07 and its documentation later removed. Useful visible FAQs can still serve readers.

sources.title: IndexNow protocol documentation
sources.notes: Supports notifying participating engines of changed URLs using key verification. Acceptance is not crawling, indexing, or ranking; do not describe it as Google submission.

sources.title: Search Console impressions, clicks, and position
sources.notes: Defines provider-specific metrics and aggregation. Average position is not a stable universal rank or an AI recommendation share.

sources.title: Search Analytics query API
sources.notes: Supports dimensions, filters, and API queries. Returned rows are not guaranteed to cover every query; privacy and service limits affect completeness.

sources.title: Debugging Search traffic drops
sources.notes: Supports segmentation and checking technical, demand, and system changes before causal conclusions.

sources.title: Ask Google to recrawl URLs
sources.notes: Supports URL Inspection requests for selected URLs and sitemaps for larger sets; repeated requests do not force earlier crawling.

sources.title: Qualify outbound links
sources.notes: Supports sponsored and ugc link relationship labels; a disclosed relationship is not an independent endorsement.

sources.title: Overview of OpenAI crawlers
sources.notes: OAI-SearchBot controls automatic search crawling; GPTBot concerns foundation-model training; ChatGPT-User serves user requests. Published IP lists support verification. Allowing access cannot promise citation.

sources.title: AI Performance in Bing Webmaster Tools
sources.notes: Describes citation counts, cited pages, sampled grounding queries, and supported Microsoft surfaces. These metrics do not indicate rank, placement, authority, or other providers.

sources.title: JSON-LD 1.1
sources.notes: Supports linked-data identifiers and graphs. JSON-LD standard conformance alone does not create search-engine recognition of a property.

sources.title: HTML custom data attributes
sources.notes: Allows application-private data-* metadata. ARWP evidence attributes are a local editorial convention, not search-engine instructions or a ranking feature.

sources.title: Data on the Web Best Practices
sources.notes: Supports persistent identifiers, provenance, quality, versions, access, and feedback. ARWP acceptance tests are proposed implementations, not W3C SEO claims.

sources.title: Schema.org Person
sources.notes: Vocabulary for real published identity and relationships. knowsAbout suggests a topic, not proof of expertise.

sources.title: Schema.org sameAs
sources.notes: Identity-equivalent references only; a related resource or admired brand is not the same entity.

sources.title: Schema.org Service
sources.notes: Vocabulary for services, providers, and areas served; no general Service rich-result promise.

sources.title: Schema.org SoftwareApplication
sources.notes: Vocabulary for application facts. Search feature eligibility must be checked independently.

sources.title: Schema.org DefinedTerm
sources.notes: Vocabulary for a defined concept and its term set; not a special AI search feature.

sources.title: Schema.org DataDownload
sources.notes: Vocabulary for dataset download representation and media properties; a described download must actually exist.

sources.title: Schema.org Claim
sources.notes: Represents a claim. Encoding a statement does not establish truth or independent fact-checking.

sources.title: Schema.org citation
sources.notes: CreativeWork citation relationships can reference works or text. A citation alone is not evidence of agreement.

sources.title: Schema.org Dataset
sources.notes: Vocabulary including measurements, coverage, and parts. Structured metadata is not verification of scientific validity.

sources.title: Accessible tables
sources.notes: Supports accessible HTML semantics and human navigation; not evidence of a search ranking effect.

sources.title: Accessible images
sources.notes: Supports accessible HTML semantics and human navigation; not evidence of a search ranking effect.

sources.title: Page structure
sources.notes: Supports accessible HTML semantics and human navigation; not evidence of a search ranking effect.

sources.title: The cite element
sources.notes: Explains cite as the title of a referenced work; the actual clickable source belongs in an anchor.

sources.title: ETag header
sources.notes: Documents HTTP validation; observed documentation includes syntax, examples, specifications, and compatibility links. Their layout is an editorial pattern, not a proven ranking cause.

sources.title: Idempotent requests
sources.notes: Observed executable request plus failure and retry boundaries. This is product documentation evidence; borrowing the structure does not prove discoverability lift.

sources.title: API upgrades
sources.notes: Observed version-aware upgrade guidance and breaking-change handling. Do not transplant Stripe-specific product behavior.

sources.title: Workers limits
sources.notes: Observed explicit resource limits and plan distinctions. Use the disclosure pattern with your own verified numbers, never copy limits as facts about another product.

sources.title: Managing repository releases
sources.notes: Observed prerequisites, CLI/browser routes, release assets, and prerelease distinctions. Actual publication must be verified separately.

sources.title: Search Generative AI performance reports in Search Console
sources.notes: Documents dedicated generative-AI impression and page reporting for Search and Discover, with worldwide rollout noted as of 2026-08-31. These observations remain included in overall performance. Authenticated property data is required; do not infer separate AI metrics from aggregate Web exports or assume API availability.

tactics.title: Return the real page state
tactics.problem: An error template can masquerade as an indexable page.
implementation: Fetch priority URLs with redirects enabled.
Return 200 for usable pages and genuine 404 or 410 for removed content.
verification: No error template returns 200 in the priority sample.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Clear HTTP states may reduce indexing confusion.
tactics.anti_pattern: Treating every 200 response as healthy content.
tactics.measurement: Track valid-content responses divided by sampled priority URLs weekly.

tactics.title: Audit robots rules by crawler
tactics.problem: A wildcard block can disable intended discovery.
implementation: Fetch the deployed root robots.txt.
Evaluate priority paths against Googlebot, Bingbot, and intended search agents.
verification: Record allow or disallow per crawler and path, including the matching rule.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Removing unintended blocks restores crawl eligibility.
tactics.anti_pattern: Using robots.txt as authentication or proof of deindexing.
tactics.measurement: Count unintentionally blocked canonical URLs before and after deployment.

tactics.title: Check snippet eligibility before AI work
tactics.problem: Preview restrictions can conflict with the desired AI-search exposure.
implementation: Inspect robots meta tags and X-Robots-Tag headers.
Document whether priority pages should allow indexing and snippets.
verification: Each target has an explicit preview policy consistent with its live directives.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Eligible indexed pages can be considered for supporting links.
tactics.anti_pattern: Promising AI inclusion after removing nosnippet.
tactics.measurement: Track priority pages with conflicting noindex or snippet directives.

tactics.title: Separate search crawling from training
tactics.problem: A single AI-bot policy can conflate independent choices.
implementation: Document OAI-SearchBot and GPTBot policies separately.
Check the deployed rules against current OpenAI documentation.
verification: A test matrix demonstrates each bot receives the intended policy.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Intentional search access removes a preventable discovery barrier.
tactics.anti_pattern: Describing GPTBot access as a requirement for ChatGPT search.
tactics.measurement: Report OAI-SearchBot policy drift separately from training-policy drift.

tactics.title: Check the CDN response as well as robots
tactics.problem: A permissive file does not bypass an edge challenge.
implementation: Probe canonical HTML through the public hostname.
Inspect trusted crawler logs and verify published IP ranges before changing narrow firewall rules.
verification: Priority HTML is accessible without a challenge under the intended verified-crawler policy.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Reducing false bot blocks may improve successful retrieval.
tactics.anti_pattern: Allowlisting a user-agent string as if it authenticated a crawler.
tactics.measurement: Measure verified search crawler challenge and 4xx rates by provider.

tactics.title: Keep the answer in initial HTML
tactics.problem: Some clients cannot recover essential content from a client-only shell.
implementation: Fetch a representative article without executing JavaScript.
Render the main answer, source links, and page identity in initial HTML.
verification: A plain HTML extraction contains the answer and its qualifications.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: More clients may retrieve complete content on their first fetch.
tactics.anti_pattern: Claiming that Google cannot render JavaScript.
tactics.measurement: Compare required-answer extraction coverage with and without JavaScript.

tactics.title: Generate canonical sitemaps from the built output
tactics.problem: Repository files do not prove public discovery artifacts exist.
implementation: Generate sitemap entries from published canonical pages.
Fetch the deployed sitemap and sample its destinations.
verification: Entries resolve to intended canonical indexable pages; lastmod reflects content changes.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Accurate discovery hints may help crawlers find changed resources.
tactics.anti_pattern: Including drafts or updating all lastmod values on every build.
tactics.measurement: Track sitemap URL validity and discovered-to-indexed lag separately.

tactics.title: Notify participating engines after real changes
tactics.problem: Repeated unchanged notifications add noise without new content.
implementation: Create a changed canonical URL set from the release diff.
Submit it to IndexNow only after verifying the host key and live content.
verification: Retain request time, URL count, response, and a separate later indexing observation.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Timely change notification may shorten discovery delays on participating engines.
tactics.anti_pattern: Calling an accepted notification an indexed page or Google submission.
tactics.measurement: Measure change-to-notification time and independently observed recrawl lag.

tactics.title: Inspect representative URLs after publication
tactics.problem: Local validation cannot identify the selected indexed version.
implementation: Select a small cohort covering templates and known failures.
Use authorized URL Inspection evidence to record indexed and live states separately.
verification: Each observation has URL, timestamp, inspection type, and evidence status.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A bounded inspection cohort may reveal real eligibility blockers earlier.
tactics.anti_pattern: Inferring indexing from site: search or a successful deployment.
tactics.measurement: Track verified indexed coverage within the fixed cohort; leave uninspected URLs unknown.

tactics.title: Give each recurring intent a primary page
tactics.problem: Overlapping articles split maintenance and confuse navigation.
implementation: Group actual reader tasks from search and support evidence.
Assign an owner URL and distinguish any necessary supporting pages.
verification: The intent map names one primary answer and the unique job of each support page.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Concentrated maintenance may improve answer completeness.
tactics.anti_pattern: Creating one page for every keyword permutation.
tactics.measurement: Track query-to-landing-page fragmentation and qualified visits per intent.

tactics.title: Build a task-based topic hub
tactics.problem: A chronological archive hides the next useful resource.
implementation: Choose a recurring task with multiple meaningful stages.
Link its prerequisites, main guide, worked example, and troubleshooting from a hub.
verification: Every link answers a named reader need and all destinations are live.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A coherent path may improve discovery of deeper useful pages.
tactics.anti_pattern: A keyword cloud with no editorial explanation.
tactics.measurement: Measure hub-to-target clicks and orphan-page count.

tactics.title: Use descriptive crawlable anchors
tactics.problem: Clickable scripts and generic labels obscure destinations.
implementation: Replace navigation-only event handlers with real href anchors.
Name the destination task in concise visible link text.
verification: An HTML link extractor finds priority destinations and meaningful labels.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Readable links support crawling and informed navigation.
tactics.anti_pattern: Stuffing all variants into anchor text.
tactics.measurement: Count priority links lacking usable href or descriptive accessible text.

tactics.title: Check discovery paths to important pages
tactics.problem: A sitemap alone can conceal pages absent from normal navigation.
implementation: Crawl links from public entry pages.
Join the discovered set with the canonical publication inventory.
verification: Each priority page has a relevant inbound internal link.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Removing orphan pages may improve both human and crawler discovery.
tactics.anti_pattern: Adding site-wide unrelated footer links solely to satisfy a counter.
tactics.measurement: Report priority orphans by template and their resolution dates.

tactics.title: Align duplicate URL signals
tactics.problem: Tracking and slash variants can disagree about the primary address.
implementation: Choose the preferred URL for each duplicate group.
Align redirects, canonical links, sitemap entries, and internal references.
verification: All sampled signals identify the same target; external selected-canonical evidence stays separate.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Consistent preferences may reduce duplicate processing.
tactics.anti_pattern: Canonicalizing genuinely different answers to one broad category.
tactics.measurement: Track conflicting canonical signals and later selected-canonical mismatches.

tactics.title: Constrain unbounded filter combinations
tactics.problem: Facets can generate an effectively endless crawl space.
implementation: Inventory index-worthy filtered views and empty combinations.
Apply a deliberate crawl and URL policy to nonessential combinations.
verification: Tests cover useful filters, empty results, reordered parameters, and repeated values.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A finite crawl surface may preserve resources for useful views.
tactics.anti_pattern: Blocking every filter without checking real demand and content value.
tactics.measurement: Compare unique crawler-requested facet URLs and useful indexed filter pages.

tactics.title: Make long collections reachable without scrolling
tactics.problem: Infinite scroll may hide records from simple clients.
implementation: Expose stable collection pages or bounded next-page href links.
Preserve record identity and avoid repeated entries across pages.
verification: A non-JavaScript walk reaches every intended public record exactly once.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Deterministic collection traversal may increase retrieval completeness.
tactics.anti_pattern: Changing results with each request or linking every page to the first canonical.
tactics.measurement: Measure reachable public records divided by published public records.

tactics.title: Reflect the visible hierarchy
tactics.problem: Markup can describe a route that readers cannot actually follow.
implementation: Choose a meaningful parent hierarchy for each template.
Render matching breadcrumbs and BreadcrumbList items.
verification: Visible labels, positions, and destination URLs agree with the JSON-LD.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Consistent hierarchy may clarify page context.
tactics.anti_pattern: Inventing keyword-heavy breadcrumb levels.
tactics.measurement: Count hierarchy mismatches and broken breadcrumb destinations.

tactics.title: Preserve answer locations during moves
tactics.problem: A redesign can discard established entry URLs.
implementation: Map old URLs to equivalent new answers before launch.
Update canonical references and test one-hop permanent redirects on the deployed host.
verification: Each priority old URL resolves to an equivalent answer or an intentional removal state.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Preserved routes may reduce avoidable migration losses.
tactics.anti_pattern: Redirecting every removed article to the homepage.
tactics.measurement: Track redirect failures and old/new URL traffic through the migration window.

tactics.title: Open with the decision and its boundary
tactics.problem: An introduction can delay the reason the reader arrived.
implementation: State the practical answer in the opening paragraph.
Name the audience, assumption, and condition that would change it.
verification: A reviewer can identify answer, audience, and main exception without scrolling.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A precise opening may improve understanding and qualified engagement.
tactics.anti_pattern: Universal advice disguised as a confident one-line answer.
tactics.measurement: Measure correct comprehension in a short reader task and downstream useful actions.

tactics.title: Publish a reproducible worked example
tactics.problem: Abstract claims are hard to apply or verify.
implementation: Choose a realistic task and provide safe inputs.
Show the actual intermediate steps, output, and a known failure.
verification: A fresh run reproduces the documented result within stated tolerances.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Concrete examples may earn references and reduce evaluation friction.
tactics.anti_pattern: Presenting an invented execution transcript as a real run.
tactics.measurement: Track successful example completion and citations to its stable URL.

tactics.title: State prerequisites before instructions
tactics.problem: Readers discover missing permissions or tools halfway through a guide.
implementation: List the versions, permissions, materials, or prior knowledge required.
Place a readiness check before the first consequential step.
verification: A new reader can determine eligibility before starting.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Early constraints may reduce abandoned attempts.
tactics.anti_pattern: Hiding paid dependencies or required expertise near the end.
tactics.measurement: Measure starts abandoned because of undisclosed prerequisites.

tactics.title: Create a symptom-to-diagnosis reference
tactics.problem: A generic troubleshooting section cannot separate similar failures.
implementation: Collect real recurring errors or symptoms.
For each, give a discriminating check, likely cause, and bounded remedy.
verification: Every remedy has an observable trigger and a way to verify recovery.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Specific failure answers may address underserved diagnostic queries.
tactics.anti_pattern: Generating dozens of guessed errors without reproductions.
tactics.measurement: Track successful resolutions and search impressions for diagnostic queries.

tactics.title: Include a case where the advice fails
tactics.problem: Readers cannot see the limits of a polished success story.
implementation: Choose the most consequential assumption in the article.
Show a counterexample and explain the alternative choice it requires.
verification: The counterexample changes a recommendation for a clearly defined circumstance.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Honest limits may improve decision quality and citation accuracy.
tactics.anti_pattern: A cosmetic cons section that never affects the conclusion.
tactics.measurement: Audit whether readers can state when to choose another approach.

tactics.title: Explain how the answer was produced
tactics.problem: A fluent article can hide its evidence and production process.
implementation: Add a short method note identifying research, testing, and material AI assistance.
Link the relevant inputs and separate observed facts from interpretation.
verification: A reviewer can trace at least the central conclusion to its method and sources.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Method transparency may make original work easier to assess.
tactics.anti_pattern: An AI-generated badge with no account of verification.
tactics.measurement: Track central claims with a reviewable method note and unresolved evidence gaps.

tactics.title: Offer concise guidance with optional technical depth
tactics.problem: Exhaustive detail can bury the main action.
implementation: Keep the decision and required steps visible.
Place derivations, logs, and edge cases in labeled sections with stable anchors.
verification: Keyboard and plain-text readers can reach all supporting content in logical order.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Layered explanation may serve both quick decisions and careful verification.
tactics.anti_pattern: Hiding qualifications in inaccessible accordions or hover-only text.
tactics.measurement: Compare task success and access to supporting evidence on mobile and desktop.

tactics.title: Define terms at the point of use
tactics.problem: Shared words can have different domain meanings.
implementation: Identify terms necessary for the current task.
Add a short contextual definition and link to a maintained term page when deeper explanation exists.
verification: Definitions distinguish nearby concepts and use consistent terminology across pages.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Clear terms may reduce entity and concept ambiguity.
tactics.anti_pattern: Generating thin dictionary pages for every word.
tactics.measurement: Measure glossary use and recurring terminology questions in feedback.

tactics.title: Answer real remaining questions without rich-result promises
tactics.problem: Template FAQs can repeat the article and chase a retired feature.
implementation: Use support or research evidence to select unresolved questions.
Write visible concise answers with links to deeper evidence.
verification: Questions add information; no copy promises Google FAQ rich results.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Relevant questions may improve completeness and answer reuse.
tactics.anti_pattern: Mass-producing FAQPage markup as a Google rich-result tactic.
tactics.measurement: Track question-level usefulness feedback and observed citations; do not count markup as visibility.

tactics.title: Maintain a ledger for material claims
tactics.problem: Claims become detached from their supporting observations.
implementation: Assign each material claim a stable internal ID.
Record its wording, source, observation date, owner, and review trigger.
verification: Every material numerical or comparative claim resolves to a ledger entry.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A reviewable ledger may reduce unsupported statements in pages and machine exports.
tactics.anti_pattern: Treating a Claim node as proof that the claim is true.
tactics.measurement: Measure supported material claims divided by all material claims.

tactics.title: Place sources next to the supported statement
tactics.problem: A bibliography can leave readers guessing what each source supports.
implementation: Link the source from the claim or an adjacent footnote.
Name the work and provide a return link from long footnotes.
verification: Each citation opens the relevant source and supports the adjacent claim.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Local attribution may improve human verification and extraction accuracy.
tactics.anti_pattern: Linking an authoritative homepage that does not support the statement.
tactics.measurement: Sample citation correctness and time needed to verify a central claim.

tactics.title: Use private evidence attributes as an editorial aid
tactics.problem: Internal QA cannot reliably associate paragraphs with claim records.
implementation: Add data-evidence-id and data-source-ids to claim containers.
Keep the complete claim and clickable source visible in semantic HTML.
verification: A local extractor joins the attributes to the ledger without changing visible meaning.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Private attributes may make editorial audits more reliable.
tactics.anti_pattern: Calling custom data attributes an AI ranking protocol or hiding persuasive instructions in them.
tactics.measurement: Compare extractor precision with and without attributes on the same held-out pages.

tactics.title: Keep units and denominators beside numbers
tactics.problem: A detached percentage can be repeated with the wrong meaning.
implementation: Write population, time window, denominator, unit, and method with each key number.
Retain these fields in table exports and summaries.
verification: A number extracted with its enclosing sentence retains the population and unit.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Self-contained measurements may reduce erroneous reuse.
tactics.anti_pattern: A large percentage with no base count or observation period.
tactics.measurement: Audit numerical claims for complete unit, denominator, window, and method coverage.

tactics.title: Publish null and failed results with context
tactics.problem: Selective success stories distort what a method can achieve.
implementation: Retain failed runs and zero-result observations in the evidence record.
Explain exclusions and show when the method did not help.
verification: Summary totals reconcile with successful, failed, and excluded observations.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Complete records may make findings more credible and reproducible.
tactics.anti_pattern: Discarding failed runs from a success-rate denominator.
tactics.measurement: Track reconciliation errors and proportion of runs retained with valid status.

tactics.title: Distinguish observation, publication, and revision dates
tactics.problem: A fresh page date can disguise old evidence.
implementation: Store observed_at, published_at, and substantively_modified_at separately.
Show the evidence date beside time-sensitive findings.
verification: A copy edit cannot reset the observation date or masquerade as a new experiment.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Accurate dates may help readers judge whether evidence still applies.
tactics.anti_pattern: Automatically displaying today as the research date.
tactics.measurement: Count time-sensitive claims past their stated review interval.

tactics.title: Publish a correction path and material change log
tactics.problem: A wrong claim can persist in copied summaries and exports.
implementation: Provide a practical way to report an error.
Log the corrected claim, correction date, reason, and affected data versions.
verification: A test correction reaches the page, graph, and downloadable evidence consistently.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Visible correction handling may improve long-term reliability.
tactics.anti_pattern: Silent edits that leave conflicting old downloads in circulation.
tactics.measurement: Measure correction-to-all-surfaces propagation time.

tactics.title: Label first-party and independent evidence
tactics.problem: Owned projects can look like independent corroboration.
implementation: Record the publisher and relationship for each endorsement or case.
Explain shared ownership when referencing another portfolio project.
verification: An evidence review distinguishes owner statements, client-approved cases, and independent reports.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Transparent relationships may prevent false authority signals.
tactics.anti_pattern: Presenting cross-links between owned sites as independent adoption.
tactics.measurement: Track relationship disclosure coverage among endorsements and comparison sources.

tactics.title: Revalidate sources that can change
tactics.problem: A working citation can still contradict a claim after a product update.
implementation: Assign source review dates based on volatility.
On review, check the relevant passage and revise dependent claims rather than only testing HTTP status.
verification: Changed or removed passages produce a claim review task with affected URLs.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Semantic source maintenance may reduce stale recommendations.
tactics.anti_pattern: Marking a source verified merely because it returns HTTP 200.
tactics.measurement: Track overdue claim reviews and material source drift detected per review cycle.

tactics.title: Use stable IDs for the same entity
tactics.problem: Different pages describe one entity as several disconnected objects.
implementation: Choose a canonical public identity URL and stable fragment ID.
Reuse it in relevant page graphs and resolve naming conflicts centrally.
verification: One entity ID maps to one identity throughout the sampled graph.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Stable identity may make relationships less ambiguous to consumers.
tactics.anti_pattern: Generating a new Person ID for each article by the same author.
tactics.measurement: Measure duplicate identities and conflicting facts per entity ID.

tactics.title: Connect authored work to a real author
tactics.problem: An anonymous content template hides accountable authorship.
implementation: Publish a useful author page with verifiable work and relevant background.
Link visible bylines and Article author IDs to that page.
verification: Visible author, article metadata, and author-page identity agree.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Explicit authorship can help readers evaluate a work.
tactics.anti_pattern: Inventing expert personas, credentials, or reviewer biographies.
tactics.measurement: Track articles with verified author identity and working evidence links.

tactics.title: Describe the actual publisher
tactics.problem: Brand names, operator names, and services can become conflated.
implementation: Identify the real publisher and its official public properties.
Add an appropriate Organization graph with only supported visible facts.
verification: The graph matches the about/contact pages and documented public identity.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Consistent publisher information may reduce identification errors.
tactics.anti_pattern: Adding fake offices, registrations, staff size, or founding dates.
tactics.measurement: Audit conflicting operator names and unsupported organization properties.

tactics.title: Reserve sameAs for identity equivalence
tactics.problem: Related topics or partner links can falsely imply the same entity.
implementation: Review every sameAs URL against the identity it describes.
Move ordinary references into visible contextual links or appropriate relationships.
verification: Every remaining sameAs target identifies the same subject.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Correct identity links may reduce graph conflation.
tactics.anti_pattern: Using Wikipedia topic pages or prestigious brands as borrowed identity.
tactics.measurement: Count invalid sameAs relationships during graph review.

tactics.title: Separate a service from its provider
tactics.problem: A tutoring offer is not the same thing as the tutor or website.
implementation: Represent the real service and its provider as distinct nodes.
Include only applicable service type, audience, availability, and area facts visible on the page.
verification: Consumers can identify who provides what without inventing a physical branch.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A clearer service model may improve task matching.
tactics.anti_pattern: Using LocalBusiness markup to manufacture an address for an online service.
tactics.measurement: Measure correctly extracted provider, service, and applicable-area facts.

tactics.title: Describe software capabilities and constraints
tactics.problem: A product name alone cannot answer compatibility questions.
implementation: List the real application category, operating environment, and supported version.
Represent accurate facts with SoftwareApplication and link detailed requirements.
verification: The graph and executable release documentation agree on support.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Explicit requirements may support more accurate product evaluation.
tactics.anti_pattern: Inventing downloads, ratings, or supported platforms to complete a template.
tactics.measurement: Track correct compatibility answers in a fixed retrieval test set.

tactics.title: Connect the page, work, and evidence
tactics.problem: A page URL and an underlying article or dataset have different roles.
implementation: Give the WebPage a mainEntity link to the actual work.
Link the work to its author, publisher, and cited evidence by stable IDs.
verification: Internal graph references resolve and represent relationships visible to readers.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Typed relationships may support faithful reuse of the evidence chain.
tactics.anti_pattern: Building a large disconnected graph with speculative relationships.
tactics.measurement: Measure resolvable reference coverage and relationship extraction accuracy.

tactics.title: Maintain a small domain term set
tactics.problem: Similar concepts are merged inconsistently across pages.
implementation: Choose terms that change a real decision or interpretation.
Define each term, stable ID, aliases, and membership in a DefinedTermSet.
verification: Aliases resolve to the intended concept without merging distinct meanings.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A precise vocabulary may improve consistency across human and machine content.
tactics.anti_pattern: Equating all semantically nearby terms to enlarge a graph.
tactics.measurement: Track terminology conflicts detected in content and retrieval answers.

tactics.title: Test visible content and graph parity
tactics.problem: Syntactically valid JSON-LD can still misrepresent a page.
implementation: Extract key entity properties from rendered HTML and JSON-LD.
Compare names, dates, prices, authors, and claims at each release.
verification: All material graph facts have visible support and no contradictory values.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Parity checks may prevent misleading machine summaries.
tactics.anti_pattern: Treating schema validation as proof of factual accuracy.
tactics.measurement: Report unsupported or contradictory graph properties by template.

tactics.title: Give a dataset a useful landing page
tactics.problem: A raw download leaves users unable to judge relevance.
implementation: Publish purpose, population, period, collection method, limitations, and access links.
Connect the page with accurate Dataset metadata.
verification: A reviewer can determine scope and retrieve the described data.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A descriptive landing page may enable relevant data discovery.
tactics.anti_pattern: Adding Dataset markup to an ordinary sales article.
tactics.measurement: Track dataset landing visits, valid downloads, and independent citations.

tactics.title: Publish a field dictionary
tactics.problem: Column names and codes are ambiguous outside their creator.
implementation: Document each field type, unit, missing-value meaning, allowed values, and examples.
Version the dictionary with the corresponding data release.
verification: Every published field has a definition consistent with sampled records.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: An explicit data contract may improve safe reuse.
tactics.anti_pattern: A dictionary generated only from column labels.
tactics.measurement: Measure dictionary coverage and field-interpretation errors in reuse tasks.

tactics.title: Expose usable machine downloads
tactics.problem: A listed export may be stale, inaccessible, or mislabeled.
implementation: Provide an actual stable CSV or JSON download with correct media type.
Describe it with DataDownload and state encoding and release version.
verification: The public download parses and matches the landing-page version and record count.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Reliable exports may make references easier to verify and reuse.
tactics.anti_pattern: Advertising API or download access that only returns a sign-up page.
tactics.measurement: Track successful parse rate and landing/download version mismatches.

tactics.title: Record transformation lineage
tactics.problem: Users cannot distinguish source observations from derived fields.
implementation: Identify source records and acquisition dates.
Publish transformation rules and label derived values separately from observations.
verification: A sample output row can be traced through each transformation to its source.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Traceable lineage may support credible original analyses.
tactics.anti_pattern: Calling a model-generated estimate an observed fact.
tactics.measurement: Measure traceable sampled rows and unexplained transformations.

tactics.title: Keep stable release identifiers
tactics.problem: A changing file makes a published result impossible to reproduce.
implementation: Assign immutable release URLs or explicit versions to cited data.
Provide a latest pointer and a short change summary linking previous releases.
verification: A saved citation retrieves the same historical release after a new publication.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Stable releases may improve citation durability.
tactics.anti_pattern: Silently overwriting a cited historical dataset.
tactics.measurement: Check historical release retrieval and reproducibility after each update.

tactics.title: Publish quality constraints with their results
tactics.problem: A polished data page can conceal missingness and duplicates.
implementation: Define domain-specific checks for key uniqueness, ranges, missingness, and referential integrity.
Publish observed failures and exclusions for each release.
verification: Reported counts reconcile with the downloadable release and quality report.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Visible quality evidence may help consumers choose suitable uses.
tactics.anti_pattern: Claiming perfect quality because JSON parses.
tactics.measurement: Track failed constraints, affected records, and unresolved quality exceptions.

tactics.title: State what the data excludes
tactics.problem: A narrow sample may be mistaken for a complete market or population.
implementation: Describe geography, time, selection criteria, and known omissions.
Represent applicable spatial and temporal coverage in Dataset metadata.
verification: Coverage statements agree with observed record boundaries.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Explicit coverage may prevent overgeneralized recommendations.
tactics.anti_pattern: Labeling a convenience sample a comprehensive benchmark.
tactics.measurement: Audit answers for correct population and time-window qualification.

tactics.title: Make reuse terms discoverable
tactics.problem: Readers cannot know whether an attractive dataset can be reused.
implementation: Choose authorized explicit license terms and attribution instructions.
Place them on the landing page, release record, and download package.
verification: License links resolve and agree across all distribution surfaces.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Clear terms may reduce friction for legitimate reuse and citations.
tactics.anti_pattern: Applying an open license to third-party data without the rights to do so.
tactics.measurement: Track unresolved license questions and compliant reuse references.

tactics.title: Show questions the data can answer
tactics.problem: A large table gives little help with useful analysis.
implementation: Select three real questions within the dataset scope.
Publish reproducible queries, small outputs, and limits of interpretation.
verification: Queries run against the named release and reproduce the shown output.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Concrete queries may make a dataset more useful as a reference.
tactics.anti_pattern: Creating a separate thin page for every possible filter.
tactics.measurement: Measure successful query reproduction and citations to worked analyses.

tactics.title: Choose comparison criteria before judging products
tactics.problem: A favorable conclusion can determine a biased scorecard.
implementation: Write the reader task and decision criteria before collecting results.
Explain why each criterion matters and how it will be measured.
verification: Every criterion maps to a task need and has a defined test or source.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Transparent criteria may improve decision usefulness.
tactics.anti_pattern: Selecting only criteria that the publisher product wins.
tactics.measurement: Measure reader agreement that criteria cover the stated decision.

tactics.title: Cite individual comparison cells
tactics.problem: A table can flatten tested facts, vendor claims, and unknowns.
implementation: Attach a source and checked date to each material cell.
Label tested, vendor-documented, inferred, and unknown values distinctly.
verification: A sampled cell can be verified without searching the entire article.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Cell-level evidence may reduce inaccurate comparative reuse.
tactics.anti_pattern: Turning missing evidence into a negative competitor claim.
tactics.measurement: Track sourced material cells and unresolved unknown cells.

tactics.title: Run the same task across compared options
tactics.problem: Different inputs can predetermine the winner.
implementation: Freeze common inputs, environment, versions, and success criteria.
Record each run and any unavoidable differences before interpreting outcomes.
verification: The run matrix shows equivalent conditions or explicit noncomparability.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Comparable trials may produce stronger first-hand evidence.
tactics.anti_pattern: Comparing a free competitor tier with a paid internal tier without disclosure.
tactics.measurement: Measure complete comparable runs and excluded noncomparable observations.

tactics.title: Recommend different options for different needs
tactics.problem: A universal winner obscures useful trade-offs.
implementation: Define scenarios where each viable option is a better fit.
Explain the decisive constraint and the evidence that changes the choice.
verification: At least one realistic condition can change the recommendation where evidence supports it.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Scenario recommendations may better answer nuanced selection queries.
tactics.anti_pattern: A best-for list where every path points to the owner product.
tactics.measurement: Test whether readers choose suitable options in predefined scenarios.

tactics.title: Expose the actual cost scenario
tactics.problem: Headline prices omit usage limits and required extras.
implementation: Specify date, currency, billing interval, workload, and included features.
Calculate the scenario total with visible assumptions and official pricing links.
verification: A reader can recompute the total and see any unavailable inputs.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Comparable cost scenarios may improve qualified choices.
tactics.anti_pattern: Inventing competitor prices or silently assuming unlimited use.
tactics.measurement: Track pricing assumptions past review date and recomputation errors.

tactics.title: Describe migration and switching work
tactics.problem: A recommendation ignores the cost of reaching the promised state.
implementation: List data export, compatibility, setup, retraining, and rollback needs.
Test one representative migration and publish blockers.
verification: The migration example identifies actual transferred data and unresolved losses.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Switching evidence may help readers evaluate practical alternatives.
tactics.anti_pattern: Claiming a seamless migration without attempting one.
tactics.measurement: Measure migration task success, elapsed effort, and uncovered blockers.

tactics.title: Publish limits beside strengths
tactics.problem: A feature list hides caps and unsupported workflows.
implementation: Maintain explicit tested limits and unsupported cases.
Link each limit to the relevant requirement, plan, or observed test.
verification: Limits are visible before the call to action and have current evidence.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Clear constraints may improve fit and reduce misleading recommendations.
tactics.anti_pattern: Using vague enterprise-ready language to conceal missing capability.
tactics.measurement: Track avoidable support requests caused by undisclosed limits.

tactics.title: Disclose the comparison publisher relationship
tactics.problem: An owner-written comparison can look like an independent review.
implementation: State ownership, sponsorship, affiliate relationships, and testing access.
Keep the same evidence standard for every product.
verification: Relationship disclosures are visible near the comparison method.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Transparent incentives may help readers assess conclusions.
tactics.anti_pattern: Inventing independent reviewers or presenting sponsored placement as an award.
tactics.measurement: Audit commercial relationship disclosure across comparison pages.

tactics.title: Build one substantial alternatives guide per decision
tactics.problem: Brand-plus-alternative pages can become repetitive doorways.
implementation: Choose an actual switching or selection task with evidence of demand.
Cover a bounded set of credible options, trade-offs, and the do-nothing option when relevant.
verification: The guide contains original decision evidence beyond substituted product names.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A substantive guide may satisfy a real selection need.
tactics.anti_pattern: Generating hundreds of templated competitor pages with identical conclusions.
tactics.measurement: Track qualified selection actions and overlap with existing owner URLs.

tactics.title: Describe the concrete service outcome
tactics.problem: Visitors cannot infer what happens after booking.
implementation: State the actual deliverable, format, duration, and responsible provider.
Show one representative authorized example or clearly labeled sample.
verification: The offer answers what is delivered, by whom, and under what scope.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Concrete service information may improve qualified discovery and conversion.
tactics.anti_pattern: Inventing client work to make an early service look established.
tactics.measurement: Measure qualified inquiries and scope-clarification questions per inquiry.

tactics.title: Explain who the service suits
tactics.problem: A broad promise attracts requests the provider cannot fulfill.
implementation: List necessary starting conditions and supported needs.
State meaningful exclusions and the next best resource for unsupported cases.
verification: A reviewer can classify realistic inquiries as suitable, unsuitable, or unknown.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Clear eligibility may improve match quality.
tactics.anti_pattern: Guaranteeing outcomes irrespective of student level or client constraints.
tactics.measurement: Track qualified-inquiry share and preventable mismatches.

tactics.title: Keep practical availability current
tactics.problem: Search visitors can reach an offer that is no longer available.
implementation: Publish supported delivery format, timezone context, and realistic booking status.
Assign an owner and refresh trigger for time-sensitive availability.
verification: Visible availability agrees with the active intake or booking workflow.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Accurate availability may reduce dead-end referrals.
tactics.anti_pattern: Fabricated scarcity counters or fake appointment slots.
tactics.measurement: Measure referrals reaching unavailable offers and availability drift duration.

tactics.title: Represent real locations honestly
tactics.problem: City pages can imply branches that do not exist.
implementation: Document the actual physical location or online service area.
Use location-specific facts only where the service genuinely differs or operates.
verification: Each public location claim has operational evidence and matching contact details.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Accurate local information may support relevant local discovery.
tactics.anti_pattern: Mass-producing city pages or virtual office claims without a real service basis.
tactics.measurement: Track location claim accuracy and qualified leads by served area.

tactics.title: Put material terms close to the offer
tactics.problem: Visitors discover important conditions after committing effort.
implementation: State applicable price basis, inclusions, cancellation process, and payment steps.
Link detailed terms from the main offer in plain language.
verification: A test visitor can identify material terms before submitting an inquiry.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Clear terms may improve informed conversion and reduce avoidable disputes.
tactics.anti_pattern: Hidden mandatory fees or unsupported money-back promises.
tactics.measurement: Measure clarification requests and abandonment at the terms step.

tactics.title: Show the real delivery process
tactics.problem: A mature-looking page gives no evidence of actual operations.
implementation: Describe intake, preparation, delivery, feedback, and follow-up stages actually used.
Identify what the client receives or does at each stage.
verification: An operator can run a sample engagement from the documented sequence.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A usable process description may make an offer easier to evaluate.
tactics.anti_pattern: Inventing a large team or elaborate process that nobody follows.
tactics.measurement: Track sample process completion and recurring intake confusion.

tactics.title: Offer a safe sample of the service
tactics.problem: Readers must trust claims without experiencing any part of the value.
implementation: Create a representative public exercise, checklist, excerpt, or demo.
Label synthetic examples and explain their relationship to the paid service.
verification: The sample works without undisclosed requirements and accurately reflects the offer.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A useful sample may attract relevant references and informed inquiries.
tactics.anti_pattern: Calling fictional sample outcomes customer results.
tactics.measurement: Measure sample completion followed by qualified service inquiries.

tactics.title: Publish verifiable cases with appropriate permission
tactics.problem: Case stories can overstate results or expose private information.
implementation: Use authorized evidence and anonymize identifiable details when required.
State baseline, intervention, observed outcome, timeframe, and limitations.
verification: The outcome has retained evidence and public wording matches publication permission.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Credible cases may support informed recommendations.
tactics.anti_pattern: Invented testimonials, logos, revenue results, or client relationships.
tactics.measurement: Track substantiated published cases and case-assisted qualified inquiries.

tactics.title: Make the next step accessible and unambiguous
tactics.problem: Visitors cannot tell whether an inquiry was received or what follows.
implementation: Provide one clear contact or booking action with expected response handling.
Test keyboard, mobile, validation, and confirmation states.
verification: A real test submission reaches the intended destination and shows an accurate confirmation.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Reliable intake may turn relevant discovery into usable demand.
tactics.anti_pattern: A decorative contact form that silently discards inquiries.
tactics.measurement: Measure successful submissions divided by attempted valid submissions.

tactics.title: Use visuals that explain original work
tactics.problem: Decorative stock imagery adds no evidence to a technical or service claim.
implementation: Capture a real process, output, or annotated diagram relevant to the page.
Explain the figure and its limitations in nearby text.
verification: A reviewer can identify the specific claim the visual supports.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Useful original visuals may support understanding and image discovery.
tactics.anti_pattern: Using generated scenes as undisclosed photographs of real clients or results.
tactics.measurement: Track figure usefulness and relevant image-search landing visits.

tactics.title: Write alternative text for the image purpose
tactics.problem: An image can be invisible to nonvisual readers.
implementation: Determine whether each image is informative, functional, complex, or decorative.
Provide purpose-appropriate alternative text or an adjacent long description.
verification: A screen-reader review preserves the information or action the image supplies.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Accessible image alternatives improve the usable content surface.
tactics.anti_pattern: Stuffing keywords into every alt attribute.
tactics.measurement: Count informative images missing meaningful alternatives.

tactics.title: Make important images crawlable and stable
tactics.problem: Expiring URLs or blocked media can undermine image discovery.
implementation: Use stable public image URLs with correct responses.
Check robots access, rendered image sources, and relevant surrounding text.
verification: Priority images resolve successfully and remain associated with the correct page.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Reliable image delivery supports discovery eligibility.
tactics.anti_pattern: Placing the primary explanatory image only in an inaccessible CSS background.
tactics.measurement: Track broken or blocked priority images and image indexing evidence separately.

tactics.title: Preserve detail without oversized downloads
tactics.problem: Heavy images slow first content while tiny versions lose useful evidence.
implementation: Create appropriately sized variants and specify dimensions.
Use responsive image markup and inspect legibility at small viewports.
verification: The selected image fits the viewport and avoids avoidable layout movement.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Efficient delivery may improve reading experience and task completion.
tactics.anti_pattern: Compressing evidence screenshots until labels become unreadable.
tactics.measurement: Measure image bytes, LCP, and legibility failures for target templates.

tactics.title: Create a watch page when viewing is the main task
tactics.problem: An incidental embed is mistaken for a dedicated video resource.
implementation: Choose videos for which watching is a real entry task.
Publish a dedicated page with a prominent player, specific title, and supporting context.
verification: The page primarily serves one video and exposes stable accessible media or player URLs.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A suitable watch page can meet video-discovery requirements.
tactics.anti_pattern: Claiming every embedded video is eligible for video indexing.
tactics.measurement: Track verified video-indexed watch pages separately from indexed web pages.

tactics.title: Publish an accurate transcript with the recording
tactics.problem: Audio-only evidence is hard to search, quote, or access.
implementation: Transcribe the published recording and review names, units, and technical terms.
Link transcript sections to the corresponding recording times where supported.
verification: Sampled transcript passages match the actual recording and retain important qualifications.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Text equivalents may improve accessibility and faithful retrieval.
tactics.anti_pattern: Publishing an AI-written summary as if it were a verbatim transcript.
tactics.measurement: Measure sampled transcript error rate and transcript-assisted task completion.

tactics.title: Keep text and media claims consistent
tactics.problem: An updated article can contradict an older diagram or recording.
implementation: List material claims shared across text, screenshots, and video.
During review, update or label the outdated formats and dates.
verification: No unqualified contradiction remains in the sampled multimodal claims.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Consistent formats may reduce ambiguous summaries.
tactics.anti_pattern: Leaving old pricing or feature claims inside an unlabeled hero video.
tactics.measurement: Track contradictions found across formats and time to correction.

tactics.title: Explain chart encodings and evidence in captions
tactics.problem: A chart detached from its axes can tell the wrong story.
implementation: State population, unit, period, source, and reading instruction in the caption.
Provide a text or table alternative for the material values.
verification: The chart can be interpreted correctly without color alone or hidden hover content.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Complete captions may make figures more reusable and understandable.
tactics.anti_pattern: A dramatic chart with truncated axes and no disclosed scale.
tactics.measurement: Audit figure interpretation accuracy and alternative-data availability.

tactics.title: Keep media attribution and reuse information attached
tactics.problem: A reused visual can lose its creator and usage conditions.
implementation: Record creator, license or permission, source, and material transformations.
Display required attribution and carry it into downloadable variants.
verification: Every public media asset has a matching rights record and required visible credit.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Clear provenance may support legitimate reuse and durable attribution.
tactics.anti_pattern: Assuming an image found online is free to republish.
tactics.measurement: Measure media assets with complete provenance and correctly propagated credit.

tactics.title: Give headings a meaningful document outline
tactics.problem: Visual styling alone does not reveal content hierarchy.
implementation: Use a descriptive main heading and nested section headings.
Check the outline independent of CSS.
verification: The heading list communicates the page topics in a sensible order.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Clear structure may improve navigation and answer location.
tactics.anti_pattern: Using headings only to make text larger or repeat target keywords.
tactics.measurement: Measure heading-outline defects and time to locate key sections.

tactics.title: Expose the main content and navigation landmarks
tactics.problem: Repeated navigation can dominate assistive reading.
implementation: Use semantic main, nav, header, and footer regions appropriately.
Add a working skip link and distinct labels for multiple navigation areas.
verification: Keyboard and screen-reader users can reach the main answer directly.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Accessible landmarks may reduce navigation friction.
tactics.anti_pattern: Adding redundant ARIA roles that conflict with native HTML.
tactics.measurement: Track keyboard steps needed to reach the primary content.

tactics.title: Make evidence tables accessible
tactics.problem: A visual grid can lose its relationships when read linearly.
implementation: Use real table markup with a caption and appropriate header associations.
Keep source notes and units connected to their rows or columns.
verification: A screen-reader pass identifies each sampled value with the correct headers.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Semantic tables may improve correct comparison and extraction.
tactics.anti_pattern: Building a data table from anonymous layout divs.
tactics.measurement: Measure correct row-column interpretation on a fixed cell sample.

tactics.title: Inspect the actual reading journey on mobile
tactics.problem: Desktop quality can hide clipped tables and unusable navigation.
implementation: Render priority templates at narrow widths with realistic content.
Fix text clipping, table access, and touch-obstructing overlays.
verification: The main answer, evidence, and next action are usable without page-level horizontal overflow.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A usable mobile journey may improve qualified engagement.
tactics.anti_pattern: Passing a viewport tag check while never reading the rendered page.
tactics.measurement: Record mobile task success and visible layout defects by template.

tactics.title: Separate real-user performance from lab scores
tactics.problem: A single fast synthetic run can mask a slow real audience.
implementation: Collect available field LCP, INP, and CLS by device and template.
Use lab traces to diagnose the worst supported field issues.
verification: Reports identify field coverage, period, device, and missing data explicitly.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Improved experienced speed may reduce task abandonment.
tactics.anti_pattern: Calling unavailable field data a passing score.
tactics.measurement: Track 75th-percentile field metrics alongside valid sample coverage.

tactics.title: Prioritize rendering the useful content
tactics.problem: Widgets can delay the answer while the page shell loads.
implementation: Identify the actual largest content element and blocking resources.
Defer nonessential scripts and prioritize necessary content assets.
verification: The main answer remains available when optional widgets fail.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Earlier useful content may improve access on slow devices.
tactics.anti_pattern: Optimizing a Lighthouse number while removing useful evidence.
tactics.measurement: Measure main-content visibility time and user task completion under constrained conditions.

tactics.title: Keep interaction responsive during the primary task
tactics.problem: Heavy handlers can make navigation and forms feel broken.
implementation: Profile the slow interaction in the actual user flow.
Break unnecessary long work and preserve progress feedback.
verification: The target interaction completes correctly under representative device constraints.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Responsive interaction may improve successful use after discovery.
tactics.anti_pattern: Reporting low INP from an idle page with no realistic interaction.
tactics.measurement: Track field INP and completion latency for the target action.

tactics.title: Reserve space for late content
tactics.problem: Unexpected movement can cause misclicks and lost reading position.
implementation: Specify dimensions for images and embeds.
Stabilize fonts, banners, and async content around the primary reading path.
verification: Loading the page does not displace the selected text or primary action unexpectedly.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Stable layout may improve reading and action reliability.
tactics.anti_pattern: Hiding all content until every asset loads.
tactics.measurement: Measure field CLS and observed layout shifts in the target flow.

tactics.title: Keep the answer reachable before promotional prompts
tactics.problem: Popups can obstruct the content visitors came to read.
implementation: Inspect first entry, returning entry, and mobile states.
Reduce intrusive overlays and provide accessible dismissal where an overlay is necessary.
verification: Users can read the main answer and access evidence without avoidable obstruction.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Reducing obstruction may improve useful engagement.
tactics.anti_pattern: An entry popup that blocks the page until an email is submitted.
tactics.measurement: Track overlay-related abandonment and access failures in usability checks.

tactics.title: Publish distinct URLs for real language versions
tactics.problem: One cookie-dependent URL can hide alternate language content.
implementation: Give each complete supported translation a stable URL.
Provide visible language navigation while retaining the selected locale.
verification: Each language URL serves the intended language without requiring a prior cookie.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Stable language versions support access and discoverability.
tactics.anti_pattern: Publishing navigation-only translations around an untranslated main article.
tactics.measurement: Track complete translated pages and locale-specific task completion.

tactics.title: Make alternate language annotations reciprocal
tactics.problem: Incomplete clusters can send inconsistent language signals.
implementation: Generate hreflang from the actual equivalent-page map.
Include self references and reciprocal fully qualified alternate URLs where applicable.
verification: Every cluster passes reciprocal URL and language-code checks.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Consistent annotations may help surface the intended version.
tactics.anti_pattern: Linking unrelated pages as language equivalents.
tactics.measurement: Count broken or nonreciprocal hreflang clusters.

tactics.title: Let readers choose a language explicitly
tactics.problem: Automatic locale redirects can trap readers or crawlers.
implementation: Offer a visible language selector using ordinary links.
Treat detection as a suggestion and preserve direct access to chosen URLs.
verification: A reader can open any supported locale without forced redirection.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Explicit access may reduce wrong-language landings.
tactics.anti_pattern: Redirecting every visitor based only on IP or browser language.
tactics.measurement: Measure forced-locale failures and language-switch completion.

tactics.title: Adapt facts as well as words
tactics.problem: A literal translation may describe unavailable services or wrong conventions.
implementation: Review currency, units, date formats, examples, availability, and terminology for each market.
Mark facts that genuinely differ by region.
verification: A knowledgeable reviewer confirms the page fits the stated locale and offer.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Accurate localization may improve relevant matches and comprehension.
tactics.anti_pattern: Pretending a translated page proves local operations.
tactics.measurement: Track locale-specific factual defects and qualified inquiries.

tactics.title: Review meaning-critical translated passages
tactics.problem: Automatic translation can reverse important qualifications.
implementation: Identify instructions, prices, limitations, and technical terms that change decisions.
Have competent reviewers compare meaning against the source version.
verification: Reviewed passages preserve the original claim and its conditions.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Meaning checks may reduce misleading localized answers.
tactics.anti_pattern: Publishing bulk translations without checking central claims.
tactics.measurement: Measure critical translation defects per reviewed page.

tactics.title: Separate translations from region-specific answers
tactics.problem: A regional guide may contain different facts from the original.
implementation: Record whether each alternate is a translation or a distinct regional answer.
Use canonical and alternate relationships according to the actual content relationship.
verification: Distinct useful regional pages are not incorrectly consolidated as duplicates.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Correct relationships may preserve useful regional information.
tactics.anti_pattern: Canonicalizing every language to English by default.
tactics.measurement: Track language-page canonical conflicts and intended indexed variants.

tactics.title: Keep translated terminology consistent
tactics.problem: A concept can acquire several incompatible translated names.
implementation: Maintain a reviewed bilingual term map for the domain.
Apply it to headings, glossaries, metadata, and learning examples.
verification: A sample of meaning-critical terms uses the agreed term or an explained alternative.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Consistent terminology may improve retrieval and learning continuity.
tactics.anti_pattern: Replacing idiomatic language with unnatural exact keyword matches.
tactics.measurement: Count unexplained term inconsistencies and reader terminology questions.

tactics.title: Collect local query evidence before expanding
tactics.problem: A global keyword list can justify pages no local audience needs.
implementation: Segment available search and inquiry evidence by supported language and region.
Select one unmet task and validate its actual local requirements.
verification: The proposed page has evidence of a real need and deliverable scope.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Evidence-led expansion may improve relevance per page created.
tactics.anti_pattern: Generating all city-language combinations from a spreadsheet.
tactics.measurement: Measure qualified regional demand against content maintenance cost.

tactics.title: Track translation freshness independently
tactics.problem: A current source page can leave translated instructions obsolete.
implementation: Link translations to the source revision they reflect.
Flag material source changes and display truthful review dates until updated.
verification: A changed instruction produces a locale review task rather than a false fresh date.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Explicit drift tracking may prevent stale localized recommendations.
tactics.anti_pattern: Updating all locale dates without reviewing their content.
tactics.measurement: Measure time from material source change to verified translation update.

tactics.title: Provide one verified path to the first useful result
tactics.problem: A feature catalog does not show whether the product can be used.
implementation: Choose a representative small task and documented prerequisites.
Run the quickstart from a fresh environment and capture the real outcome.
verification: A new evaluator completes the stated result using only public instructions.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A reliable first result may improve product evaluation and references.
tactics.anti_pattern: Claiming a quickstart works because the package compiles.
tactics.measurement: Measure independent quickstart completion and time to useful output.

tactics.title: Use a consistent reference entry structure
tactics.problem: Readers cannot find parameter meaning or failure behavior.
implementation: For each supported feature, document purpose, inputs, output, example, limits, and related tasks.
Link to the authoritative specification where one exists.
verification: A reader can answer a fixed set of usage questions from each sampled entry.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Predictable references may make accurate retrieval easier.
tactics.anti_pattern: Padding every reference with generic SEO introductions.
tactics.measurement: Measure reference answer coverage and incorrect usage caused by missing information.

tactics.title: State which version the documentation describes
tactics.problem: Current documentation can be applied to incompatible older releases.
implementation: Show the supported version and link migration notes.
Maintain version-specific pages only where behavior materially differs.
verification: Examples and requirements match the named release.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Version context may reduce unsuitable recommendations and failed integrations.
tactics.anti_pattern: Calling unreleased main-branch behavior generally available.
tactics.measurement: Track docs/release mismatches and version-related support failures.

tactics.title: Link release claims to actual artifacts
tactics.problem: A roadmap can be mistaken for a shipped capability.
implementation: Separate available, preview, planned, and retired features.
Link availability claims to the actual release and installable artifact.
verification: A reviewer can obtain the release that contains each claimed public capability.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Release evidence may improve truthful product assessment.
tactics.anti_pattern: Fake adoption badges, fabricated download counts, or a roadmap presented as delivery.
tactics.measurement: Measure public capability claims with verified released artifacts.

tactics.title: Publish an explicit operational limits reference
tactics.problem: Integration failures reveal limits absent from marketing.
implementation: List applicable size, rate, concurrency, storage, and environment limits.
State which limits are measured, configured, or provider-documented.
verification: Each limit has a source or repeatable boundary test and applicable version.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Limits disclosure may help agents and users select suitable tools.
tactics.anti_pattern: Claiming production scale from a tiny local smoke test.
tactics.measurement: Track limit-related incidents and correctly answered capacity questions.

tactics.title: Document retries and partial failures
tactics.problem: A consumer can repeat a mutation and duplicate work.
implementation: For consequential operations, explain idempotency, retry conditions, and partial completion.
Provide a safe example showing recovery without duplicating the operation.
verification: The documented failure scenario is reproducible in a test environment.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Explicit failure behavior may improve reliable agent use.
tactics.anti_pattern: Promising safe retries for operations without implementation support.
tactics.measurement: Measure duplicate operations and recovery success in bounded integration tests.

tactics.title: Make breaking changes actionable
tactics.problem: A changelog names a change without helping existing users adapt.
implementation: Show the old behavior, new behavior, affected versions, and migration steps.
Provide a small before/after example with verification and rollback where feasible.
verification: A representative old integration migrates successfully using the guide.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Practical migration guidance may preserve useful adoption.
tactics.anti_pattern: A migration page consisting only of a release announcement.
tactics.measurement: Track migration completion and unresolved version-specific blockers.

tactics.title: Document every real way to access the product
tactics.problem: The site advertises APIs or agents without usable discovery.
implementation: Inventory canonical HTML, exports, search, APIs, and agent interfaces actually deployed.
Publish their exact locations, access requirements, and capability limits in the profile.
verification: Each advertised interface resolves and passes its relevant read-only capability check.
